title: Practice 7: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ты не ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 2nd sg.) в Боснию на каникулы.
exercises.why: **поедешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».
exercises.prompt: You aren't going to Bosnia on vacation.

exercises.q: Я ___ (сплавать — to swim there and back; pf., past m. sg.) до другого конца бассейна.
exercises.why: **сплавал** — past tense (masculine) of сплавать: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I swam to the other end of the pool and back.

exercises.q: Я всегда хотел ___ (поездить — to ride about for a while; pf., inf.) по Европе.
exercises.why: **поездить** — infinitive, the perfective of ездить meaning «for a while».
exercises.prompt: I've always wanted to travel through Europe.

exercises.q: Неискренний подарок впрок не ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **пойдёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: One won't profit by an insincere gift.

exercises.q: Я сегодня ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., past m. sg.) в океанариум.
exercises.why: **сходил** — past tense (masculine) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: I went to the aquarium today.

exercises.q: Недалёк тот день, когда мы сможем ___ (полететь — to fly off; pf., inf.) на Марс.
exercises.why: **полететь** — infinitive, the perfective of лететь, «set out».
exercises.prompt: It won't be long before we can travel to Mars.

exercises.q: Ветка начала гнуться, когда я ___ (полезть — to start climbing; pf., past m. sg.) по ней.
exercises.why: **полез** — past tense (masculine) of полезть: the perfective of лезть, «set out».
exercises.prompt: The branch began to bend as I climbed along it.

exercises.q: Давай ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) в ботанический сад.
exercises.why: **сходим** — present tense (1st person plural) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.
exercises.prompt: Let's go to the botanical garden.

exercises.q: Издалека островок ___ (походить — to walk about for a while; impf., past m. sg.) на черепаху.
exercises.why: **походил** — past tense (masculine) of походить: the perfective of ходить meaning «for a while».
exercises.prompt: The islet resembled a tortoise from afar.

exercises.q: Птица подобрала прутик клювом и ___ (полететь — to fly off; pf., past f. sg.) к своему гнезду.
exercises.why: **полетела** — past tense (feminine) of полететь: the perfective of лететь, «set out».
exercises.prompt: The bird picked up the twig with its beak and flew to its nest.

exercises.q: Казу сказал ей, что в мае ___ (поехать — to set off (by vehicle); pf., fut. 3rd sg.) в Бразилию.
exercises.why: **поедет** — future tense (3rd person singular) of поехать: the perfective of ехать, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Kazu told her that he would go to Brazil in May.

exercises.q: Может, мы ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., fut. 1st pl.) вечерком куда-нибудь?
exercises.why: **сходим** — present tense (1st person plural) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Shall we maybe go somewhere tonight?

exercises.q: Я ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past m. sg.) на однодневную экскурсию.
exercises.why: **съездил** — past tense (masculine) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.

exercises.q: I only meant to buy one gift, but I got carried away and bought half the store.
exercises.why: **понесло** — past tense (neuter) of понести: the perfective of нести, «set out».
exercises.ru: Я собиралась купить только один подарок, но меня ___, и я скупила полмагазина.

exercises.q: Сегодня чудный день, чтобы ___ (побегать — to run about for a while; pf., inf.) по пляжу.
exercises.why: **побегать** — infinitive, the perfective of бегать meaning «for a while».
exercises.prompt: Today is a wonderful day for jogging on the beach.

exercises.q: Том ___ (съездить — to go and come back (by vehicle); pf., past m. sg.) на однодневную экскурсию.
exercises.why: **съездил** — past tense (masculine) of съездить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.

exercises.q: После неловкой паузы Билл взял ее за руку и ___ (потащить — to drag off; pf., past m. sg.) наверх.
exercises.why: **потащил** — past tense (masculine) of потащить: the perfective of тащить, «set out».
exercises.prompt: After an awkward pause, Bill took her by the hand and dragged her upstairs.

exercises.q: ___ (сходить — to go and come back (on foot); pf., imper. sg.) в хозяйственный магазин и купи шурупов.
exercises.why: **сходи** — imperative (ты, singular) of сходить: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.
exercises.prompt: Go to the hardware store and get screws.

exercises.q: Отец никогда тебя не простит, если ты ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot); pf., fut. 2nd sg.) в спецназ.
exercises.why: **пойдёшь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
exercises.prompt: Dad will never forgive you if you join the special forces.
